label: s32_st_mara_the_long_way
title: The Long Way
summary: Mara's non-mystery scene, required by the Act 1 rule that every central character has one. She walks the player back the long way for no stated reason. A dog, a gate, and how long it takes to stop being new somewhere. Moves player->mara, which almost nothing else does: this is where the player's own view of her changes, and later scenes read it.
